claims.text: The FOMC decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.

citations.quotation: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent

claims.text: The Committee expects to maintain the federal funds rate target range until labor market conditions reach levels consistent with its maximum employment assessments and inflation has risen to 2 percent and is on track to moderately exceed 2 percent for some time.

citations.quotation: expects it will be appropriate to maintain this target range until labor market conditions have reached levels consistent with the Committee's assessments of maximum employment and inflation has risen to 2 percent and is on track to moderately exceed 2 percent for some time

claims.text: The Committee continues to increase holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month.

citations.quotation: it would continue to increase its holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month

claims.text: The Committee continues to increase holdings of agency mortgage-backed securities by at least $40 billion per month.

citations.quotation: and of agency mortgage‑backed securities by at least $40 billion per month

claims.text: Asset purchases continue until substantial further progress is made toward maximum employment and price stability goals.

citations.quotation: until substantial further progress has been made toward its maximum employment and price stability goals

claims.text: The Committee identified that risks to the economic outlook remain, even as vaccination progress likely reduces the effects of the public health crisis.

citations.quotation: Progress on vaccinations will likely continue to reduce the effects of the public health crisis on the economy, but risks to the economic outlook remain.

claims.text: The Committee stated it would be prepared to adjust the stance of monetary policy if risks emerge that could impede attainment of its goals.

citations.quotation: The Committee would be prepared to adjust the stance of monetary policy as appropriate if risks emerge that could impede the attainment of the Committee's goals.

counterarguments.text: The statement notes the economy has already made progress toward the Committee's goals since the December announcement, which could be read as a signal that any change to the pace of purchases was being contemplated, though the statement leaves purchases unchanged.

citations.quotation: Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals, and the Committee will continue to assess progress in coming meetings.
